name: leukocyte receptor tyrosine kinase
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: LTK encodes leukocyte tyrosine kinase receptor. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Kinase-altered spindle cell neoplasm (non-NTRK), malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
